bagPolicy.summary: Bags must be no larger than 30 x 20 x 10 cm, and the stadium discourages bringing any bag.
allowed: Bags up to 30 x 20 x 10 cm
prohibited: Bags larger than 30 x 20 x 10 cm
Glass, hard plastic or metal containers of any size
bagPolicy.note: Lockers outside the stadium at the bottom of the north and south access ramps start at 3 euros. Check the event page for concert-specific rules.

parking.summary: Concert visitors can use stadium or remote parking with event-specific access reservations; the operator recommends booking before travel.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The official venue guidance does not specify a general rideshare pickup location for concerts; consult the event instructions.
rideshare.note: For taxi drop-off on event days, enter through Gate 1. The drop-off area is alongside the training centre.

concessions.summary: Food and drink outlets operate inside and outside the stadium; offerings depend on the event.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The stadium provides accessible booking and arrival guidance; request disability seating or parking using the operator’s form.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The official venue guidance does not specify a general concert re-entry rule for concerts; consult the event instructions.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: There are no ticket sales on site on event days. Mobile tickets are accepted if your screen is bright and the barcode is readable, but a printed purchase confirmation will not get you in. Bring your ticket and a photo ID.

gates.summary: The official venue guidance does not specify a general concert gate-opening time for concerts; consult the event instructions.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
